roadmap.title: Story campaign and finite opportunities
roadmap.description: Play the campaign while clearing the three finite side opportunities before the finale. Choose The Third Way to retain every protagonist for later cleanup.

roadmap.title: Story Mode completion and collectibles
roadmap.description: Finish the 100% checklist, collectibles, medal grind, aerial challenges, property tasks, and first-person timer after the campaign opens the full toolkit.

roadmap.title: Director Mode and Rockstar Editor
roadmap.description: Use the completed Story save to unlock actor categories, collect Peyote Plants, sweep Director Mode locations, and use the Enhanced Director Mode entry alternatives.

roadmap.title: GTA Online foundations
roadmap.description: Complete Online onboarding, build one character to Rank 100, and clear the original competitive, freemode, property, and lifestyle requirements.

roadmap.title: Original GTA Online Heists
roadmap.description: Run Lester's five apartment Heists, then clean up hosting, equal cuts, no-damage, vehicle spending, and Platinum Medal requirements.

roadmap.title: The Doomsday Heist
roadmap.description: Complete all three acts, then organize experienced fixed teams for the Elite Challenges and the separate two-, three-, and four-player Criminal Mastermind runs.

achievements.description: Repo a car and race it through Los Santos as Franklin.
achievements.summary: Complete the Story Mode mission @mechanic{Franklin and Lamar}.

guide.context: This is an automatic story unlock, so no optional medal objective is required.

steps.text: Advance the main story and finish @mechanic{Franklin and Lamar}; the achievement registers after the mission completes.

achievements.description: Reunite Michael with an old friend.
achievements.summary: Complete the Story Mode mission @mechanic{Fame or Shame}.

guide.context: This is an automatic story unlock, so no optional medal objective is required.

steps.text: Advance the main story and finish @mechanic{Fame or Shame}; the achievement registers after the mission completes.

achievements.description: Complete the getaway after Caida Libre.
achievements.summary: Complete the Story Mode mission @mechanic{Caida Libre}.

guide.context: This is an automatic story unlock, so no optional medal objective is required.

steps.text: Advance the main story and finish @mechanic{Caida Libre}; the achievement registers after the mission completes.

achievements.description: Complete Bury the Hatchet and uncover the truth about Brad.
achievements.summary: Complete the Story Mode mission @mechanic{Bury the Hatchet}.

guide.context: This is an automatic story unlock, so no optional medal objective is required.

steps.text: Advance the main story and finish @mechanic{Bury the Hatchet}; the achievement registers after the mission completes.

achievements.displayName: To Live or Die in Los Santos
achievements.description: Complete the final Story Mode mission.
achievements.summary: Resolve Story Mode's final choice through @mechanic{The Third Way}, @mechanic{Something Sensible}, or @mechanic{The Time's Come}.

guide.context: Option C, The Third Way, preserves all three protagonists and avoids losing access to character-specific cleanup tasks.

steps.text: Reach the final choice after @mechanic{The Big Score}.
Choose @mechanic{Deathwish} to start @mechanic{The Third Way}, then finish the mission.
steps.note: Either other ending awards this achievement, but removes one protagonist from normal free roam.

achievements.description: Complete the Vangelico heist.
achievements.summary: Complete the Story Mode mission @mechanic{The Jewel Store Job}.

guide.context: This is an automatic story unlock, so no optional medal objective is required.

steps.text: Advance the main story and finish @mechanic{The Jewel Store Job}; the achievement registers after the mission completes.

achievements.description: Complete the Merryweather operation.
achievements.summary: Complete the Story Mode mission @mechanic{The Merryweather Heist}.

guide.context: This is an automatic story unlock, so no optional medal objective is required.

steps.text: Advance the main story and finish @mechanic{The Merryweather Heist}; the achievement registers after the mission completes.

achievements.description: Complete the Paleto Bay heist.
achievements.summary: Complete the Story Mode mission @mechanic{The Paleto Score}.

guide.context: This is an automatic story unlock, so no optional medal objective is required.

steps.text: Advance the main story and finish @mechanic{The Paleto Score}; the achievement registers after the mission completes.

achievements.description: Complete the FIB building operation.
achievements.summary: Complete the Story Mode mission @mechanic{The Bureau Raid}.

guide.context: This is an automatic story unlock, so no optional medal objective is required.

steps.text: Advance the main story and finish @mechanic{The Bureau Raid}; the achievement registers after the mission completes.

achievements.description: Complete the final major heist.
achievements.summary: Complete the Story Mode mission @mechanic{The Big Score}.

guide.context: This is an automatic story unlock, so no optional medal objective is required.

steps.text: Advance the main story and finish @mechanic{The Big Score}; the achievement registers after the mission completes.

achievements.description: Earn any 70 Gold Medals on Missions, Strangers and Freaks.
achievements.summary: Earn 70 @mechanic{Gold Medals} across replayable Story Missions and Strangers & Freaks missions.

guide.context: Mission objectives accumulate across replays, so different Gold requirements can be completed on separate attempts.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Pause > Game > Replay Mission} and inspect the unfinished medal objectives for a mission.
Replay short missions and complete the missing objectives until that mission reaches Gold.
Continue until the combined Gold-Medal counter across Story Missions and Strangers & Freaks reaches 70.

achievements.description: Attain 100% Game Completion.
achievements.summary: Reach @mechanic{100% Story Mode completion}: 69 story missions, all checklist-marked Franklin Strangers & Freaks missions, 14 random events, 42 hobbies, and 16 miscellaneous tasks.

guide.context: Only checklist-marked activities count; use the Story Mode checklist rather than trying to clear every optional activity in the game.

steps.text: Complete all 69 story missions, including Lester's five assassination missions.
Complete every required Franklin Strangers & Freaks chain and any 14 random events.
Finish all required races, shooting-range sets, Flight School lessons, parachute jumps, triathlons, golf, tennis, darts, and the private dance.
Complete the required collectibles and miscellaneous checklist items, including 50 Letter Scraps, 50 Spaceship Parts, 25 Under the Bridge challenges, 8 Knife Flights, and 25 Stunt Jumps.
Open @mechanic{Pause > Stats > 100% Checklist} and finish every remaining colored entry until the total reaches 100%.

achievements.displayName: All's Fare in Love and War
achievements.description: Purchase Downtown Cab Co. and complete a private fare.
achievements.summary: As Franklin, buy @loc{Downtown Cab Co.} for $200,000 and complete one manager-requested private fare.

guide.context: Private fares arrive by a call from manager Raul after the property purchase; ordinary taxi work does not satisfy the property mission.

steps.text: Switch to Franklin and purchase @loc{Downtown Cab Co.} in East Vinewood for $200,000.
Continue playing or save and advance time until @npc{Raul} calls with a private-fare request, then accept the call.
Drive to the @mechanic{P} marker, collect the passenger, and finish the requested destination or follow-up task.

achievements.description: Purchase McKenzie Field Hangar and win the arms race.
achievements.summary: As Trevor, buy @loc{McKenzie Field Hangar} for $150,000 and finish all five ground and five air trafficking runs.

guide.context: The Dune Buggy starts ground deliveries and the Cuban 800 starts air deliveries; both ten-run chains are required.

steps.text: Switch to Trevor and purchase @loc{McKenzie Field Hangar} in Grapeseed for $150,000.
Enter the hangar's @item{Dune Buggy} and complete five ground arms-trafficking missions.
Enter the hangar's @item{Cuban 800} and complete five air arms-trafficking missions.

achievements.description: Attain a gold medal in all applicable hobbies and pastimes.
achievements.summary: Earn one @mechanic{Gold Medal} in each of six pastime types: Shooting Range, Flight School, Off-Road Race, Sea Race, Street Race, and Triathlon.

guide.context: Only one Gold result per category is needed, making the shortest early event in each category the efficient route.

steps.text: Earn Gold in one @loc{Ammu-Nation Shooting Range} challenge and one @loc{Flight School} lesson.
Win one Off-Road Race, one Sea Race, and one Triathlon.
As Franklin between 20:00 and 05:00, complete Hao's first Street Race with a Gold result.

achievements.description: Collect and return all spaceship parts.
achievements.summary: After @mechanic{Far Out}, collect all 50 @item{Spaceship Parts} and complete Omega's @mechanic{The Final Frontier}.

guide.context: The parts appear only after Franklin meets Omega following Fame or Shame, although any protagonist may collect them afterward.

steps.text: As Franklin, complete @mechanic{Far Out} for @npc{Omega} in Sandy Shores.
Open the Rockstar Games @mechanic{Career > Checklist} page for the active Story save and filter the map to @item{Spaceship Parts}; clear every unfinished marker.
Collect all 50 glowing, humming @item{Spaceship Parts} across Los Santos and Blaine County.
Return as Franklin and complete @mechanic{The Final Frontier} when Omega's final marker appears.

achievements.description: Solve the mystery of Leonora Johnson.
achievements.summary: Collect all 50 @item{Letter Scraps}, then have Franklin complete @mechanic{A Starlet in Vinewood} and kill Peter Dreyfuss.

guide.context: Letter Scraps exist from the start and may be collected by any protagonist, but Franklin must resolve the unlocked Killer mission.

steps.text: Open the Rockstar Games @mechanic{Career > Checklist} page for the active Story save and filter the map to @item{Letter Scraps}; clear every unfinished marker.
Collect all 50 glowing @item{Letter Scraps} across the map.
Switch to Franklin and enter the green @mechanic{Killer} question-mark marker.
Complete @mechanic{A Starlet in Vinewood} and kill @npc{Peter Dreyfuss} before he escapes.

achievements.description: Purchase the old dock and collect all nuclear waste.
achievements.summary: Buy @loc{Sonar Collections Dock} for $250,000 and collect all 30 @item{Nuclear Waste} barrels.

guide.context: Purchasing the dock unlocks its submersible and the Trackify sonar, which points to the nearest barrel even though the world map does not.

steps.text: After @mechanic{The Merryweather Heist}, purchase @loc{Sonar Collections Dock} on the western coast.
Enter the yellow submersible at the dock and follow the @mechanic{Trackify} radar toward each barrel.
Collect all 30 underwater @item{Nuclear Waste} barrels.

achievements.description: Complete all Rampages.
achievements.summary: As Trevor, complete all five @mechanic{Rampage} missions.

guide.context: The first Rampage opens after Friends Reunited; completing each skull-marked fight reveals the remaining chain.

steps.text: After @mechanic{Friends Reunited}, start Trevor's first Rampage near the Sandy Shores liquor store.
Meet each Rampage's displayed kill and weapon conditions before its timer expires.
Finish all five Rampages in Sandy Shores, Rancho, Chamberlain Hills, Fort Zancudo Approach, and Mirror Park.

achievements.description: Complete all Stunt Jumps.
achievements.summary: Successfully land all 50 unique @mechanic{Stunt Jumps} in Story Mode.

guide.context: Each jump has a specific landing zone and speed window; an on-screen success message confirms that the location counted.

steps.text: Use Franklin and a controllable motorcycle such as the @item{Pegassi Bati 801}.
Quick-save before each mapped Stunt Jump, take the ramp, and land upright inside its required zone.
Repeat failed landings and continue until all 50 unique jumps display completion.

achievements.description: Complete your path to enlightenment... or not.
achievements.summary: As Michael, complete the entire @mechanic{Epsilon Program} mission chain through @mechanic{Unknowing the Truth}.

guide.context: The chain requires $90,500 for donations, robes, and the final offering, plus ten in-game days in Epsilon robes and a five-mile desert pilgrimage.

steps.text: As Michael, visit @mechanic{epsilonprogram.com}, complete the evaluation, and follow the first Raton Canyon marker.
Donate $500 and then $5,000 when requested, completing each new Epsilon marker as it appears.
Deliver the Declasse Tornado, Pegassi Vacca, Benefactor Surano, Enus Super Diamond, and Dinka Double-T.
Donate $10,000, buy the $25,000 Epsilon robes, wear them for ten in-game days, and complete the aircraft delivery.
Walk or run five miles inside the desert while wearing the robes, then answer the call and bring $50,000 to @mechanic{Unknowing the Truth}.
Finish the final convoy by either delivering the money or escaping with it.

achievements.description: Survive 3 minutes on at least a 3 star Wanted Level with all three characters together off mission.
achievements.summary: Off mission, keep Michael, Franklin, and Trevor together through three minutes at a three-star-or-higher Wanted Level.

guide.context: The achievement becomes unavailable on a save where either Michael or Trevor is killed in the ending, so complete it before the final choice or choose The Third Way.

steps.text: After Trevor becomes playable, use one protagonist's phone to call the other two for a hangout.
Collect both companions in a four-door vehicle while no mission is active.
Drive onto @loc{Los Santos International Airport} to trigger three wanted stars, then evade police inside the airfield without losing the stars or a companion for three minutes.

achievements.description: You're gonna need a bigger boat...
achievements.summary: Travel into deep ocean water and let a @enemy{Shark} kill the active Story Mode protagonist.

guide.context: A shark appears as a red hostile dot once the boat or swimmer reaches dark-blue offshore water.

steps.text: Take a boat or Jet Ski into deep ocean water until the minimap turns dark blue.
Watch for a red hostile dot, enter the water near the @enemy{Shark}, and remain within its reach until its attack kills the protagonist.

achievements.description: Deliver an unsuspecting victim to the Altruist Cult.
achievements.summary: As Trevor, divert one eligible hitchhiker or passenger random event to the @loc{Altruist Cult} camp.

guide.context: Eligible passenger events are finite and cannot be replayed after delivery, so taking every passenger to the requested destination can exhaust the opportunities.

steps.text: Switch to Trevor and drive along the road at the southern foot of @loc{Mount Chiliad} until the blue-dot hitchhiker appears.
Let the passenger enter Trevor's vehicle, then ignore the requested destination and follow the @mechanic{A} marker west of Mount Chiliad.
Drive through the gate of the @loc{Altruist Cult} camp to hand over the passenger.

achievements.description: Spend a total of $200 million across all three characters.
achievements.summary: Accumulate $200 million of Story Mode spending across Michael, Franklin, and Trevor.

guide.context: Stock purchases count as spending even when the shares are immediately sold, letting the same capital contribute repeatedly.

steps.text: Finish the story and retain a large cash balance on one or more protagonists.
Open the phone browser, choose @mechanic{Money and Services}, and invest the available balance through LCN or BAWSAQ.
Immediately sell the shares, then repeat buying and selling until @mechanic{Pause > Stats > Cash > Money Spent} exceeds $200 million.

achievements.description: Make a profit over your total investments in the stock market.
achievements.summary: Sell any Story Mode stock position for more money than its purchase cost.

guide.context: The unlock checks realized profit, so the shares must be sold after their market value rises.

steps.text: Use a protagonist's phone browser to open @mechanic{Money and Services}, then enter LCN or BAWSAQ.
Buy a small position in several companies and advance time by sleeping.
Open @mechanic{My Portfolio} and sell one position showing a positive return.

achievements.description: Fully mod a weapon.
achievements.summary: At @loc{Ammu-Nation}, fully modify one compatible weapon by buying every functional upgrade.

guide.context: A basic Pistol is inexpensive and exposes the required Extended Clip, Flashlight, and Suppressor slots.

steps.text: At @loc{Ammu-Nation}, select the standard @item{Pistol} from the display case.
Purchase the @item{Extended Clip}, @item{Flashlight}, and @item{Suppressor}, plus any available finish required to clear the weapon's modification list.

achievements.description: Deliver a bail bond target alive.
achievements.summary: As Trevor, capture a Maude bail-bond target alive and deliver the restrained target to @npc{Maude}.

guide.context: There are four targets; killing all four removes the chance to make a live delivery on that save.

steps.text: After @mechanic{Mr. Philips}, meet @npc{Maude} at the orange question mark east of Sandy Shores and wait for her target email.
Follow the email photograph to @loc{Davis Quartz quarry} and confront @npc{Ralph Ostrowski}, Maude's first target.
Shoot the tires of Ralph's escape vehicle or use a Stun Gun, then avoid lethal damage until he surrenders.
Let the target enter Trevor's vehicle and drive back to Maude's trailer.

achievements.description: Fully mod a vehicle.
achievements.summary: After @mechanic{Father/Son}, buy one modification in every available category for the same eligible vehicle and leave @loc{Los Santos Customs}.

guide.context: Different vehicles expose different categories; a cheap, highly customizable car such as the Weeny Issi avoids missing a required slot.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Father/Son}, acquire a @item{Weeny Issi}, and make a manual save.

Enter @loc{Los Santos Customs} and purchase an option under every available category, including armor, brakes, bumpers, engine, exhaust, hood, horn, lights, plate, respray, skirts, suspension, transmission, turbo, wheels, tires, smoke, and windows.
Exit the shop after all categories have a purchased option.

achievements.description: Complete all Under the Bridge and Knife Flight challenges.
achievements.summary: Complete all 50 @mechanic{Under the Bridge} challenges and all 15 @mechanic{Knife Flights}.

guide.context: Contact with a bridge, nearby structure, or ground invalidates an attempt; each successful location produces an on-screen counter.

steps.text: Use a stable helicopter to fly cleanly under all 50 marked bridges without touching the bridge or ground.
Complete Flight School to improve aircraft control, then use a plane to fly sideways through all 15 marked Knife Flight gaps.
Repeat any location that did not display its completion notification until both counters are full.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Complete the Introduction.
achievements.summary: Create a GTA Online character and complete the introduction through the tutorial race and first free-roam release.

guide.context: The tutorial also establishes the starter character and insured vehicle used by several later Online requirements.

steps.text: Start GTA Online with a new character and choose to play the tutorial.
Complete Lamar's opening sequence and the tutorial race, then continue until normal free roam becomes available.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Reach Rank 25.
achievements.summary: Reach GTA Online Rank 25 on one character by accumulating 127,100 RP.

guide.context: Rank progress belongs to an individual Online character rather than the account-wide sum across multiple characters.

steps.text: Complete GTA Online Jobs, Heists, races, daily objectives, and freemode activities to earn RP.
Continue on the same character until the rank display reaches 25.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Reach Rank 50.
achievements.summary: Reach GTA Online Rank 50 on one character by accumulating 448,800 RP.

guide.context: Rank progress belongs to an individual Online character rather than the account-wide sum across multiple characters.

steps.text: Complete GTA Online Jobs, Heists, races, daily objectives, and freemode activities to earn RP.
Continue on the same character until the rank display reaches 50.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Reach Rank 100.
achievements.summary: Reach GTA Online Rank 100 on one character by accumulating 2,165,850 RP.

guide.context: Rank progress belongs to an individual Online character rather than the account-wide sum across multiple characters.

steps.text: Complete GTA Online Jobs, Heists, races, daily objectives, and freemode activities to earn RP.
Continue on the same character until the rank display reaches 100.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Obtain first place in all competitive game types.
achievements.summary: Win Air, Land, Sea, GTA, and Rally Races; Arm Wrestling, Darts, Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Golf, Parachuting, Tennis, and the Shooting Range's Target Grid, Cover Target, and Random Target matches; then finish all ten Survival waves and one Gang Attack, using Rockstar Created Jobs wherever a category starts from Jobs.

guide.context: Progress appears in the Rockstar Games Victory Awards tracker, and completing another Job can force a delayed achievement to synchronize.

steps.text: Where a category starts from Jobs, play a Rockstar Created Job. Win an Air Race, Land Race, Sea Race, GTA Race, Rally Race, Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Arm Wrestling match, Darts match, Golf match, Tennis match, and Parachuting event.
Complete all ten waves of a Survival and finish a Gang Attack.
Win each Shooting Range match type: Target Grid, Cover Target, and Random Target.
Check the Rockstar Games @mechanic{Victory Awards} tracker, then complete another Job if the achievement does not synchronize immediately.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Use custom vehicles to win 5 races.
achievements.summary: Win five GTA Online races while driving a personally owned, modified vehicle.

guide.context: Custom vehicles must be enabled in the race lobby, and the owned vehicle must be selected before each start.

steps.text: Own a vehicle, modify it at a compatible workshop, and store it as a personal vehicle.
Host or join a race with @mechanic{Custom Vehicles} enabled and select the modified personal vehicle.
Finish first in five races while using that vehicle.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Complete all 10 waves of a Survival.
achievements.summary: Complete Wave 10 of one GTA Online @mechanic{Survival}.

guide.context: Survival is also one of the completion requirements for Numero Uno, so one full ten-wave run advances both achievements.

steps.text: Launch a Rockstar Created Survival with stocked weapons, armor, and snacks.
Use cover and clear every enemy wave without the entire team being eliminated.
Finish Wave 10 and reach the results screen.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Direct a driver to 1st place as co-driver in Rally Mode.
achievements.summary: As co-driver in a four-player @mechanic{Rally Race}, direct your driver to a first-place finish.

guide.context: Rally requires two two-person cars; only co-drivers see checkpoints, so communication or the directional prompts are essential.

steps.text: Start a standard race with @mechanic{Race Type > Rally} and at least four players.
Join the winning car as @mechanic{Co-Driver}, then call checkpoint directions or use the on-screen arrow prompts for the driver.
Finish the Rally Race in first place while remaining the co-driver.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Survive for a day with a Bounty on your head.
achievements.summary: Keep a GTA Online bounty on your character for one full in-game day, equal to 48 real minutes.

guide.context: Another player can place the bounty, or stealing an occupied civilian car can cause its NPC owner to request one.

steps.text: Have another player place a bounty through Lester, or steal occupied civilian vehicles until an NPC places a bounty.
Remain alive in GTA Online for 48 real minutes while the bounty skull is active.
Avoid being killed by another player until the game pays the bounty to your character.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Finish a Gang Attack without dying and kill at least 10 enemies.
achievements.summary: Complete one GTA Online @mechanic{Gang Attack} without dying and personally kill at least ten enemies.

guide.context: Gang Attacks are time-of-day freemode events marked by a red circle only when the character is near an active location.

steps.text: Enter an active red-circle Gang Attack location in freemode.
Stay inside the event area, use cover, and personally kill at least ten gang members without dying.
Eliminate every remaining enemy to complete the Gang Attack.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Earn 30 Platinum Awards.
achievements.summary: Raise 30 different GTA Online Awards to @mechanic{Platinum}.

guide.context: Award progress is tracked under Pause > Stats > Awards; choose short cumulative awards across several categories rather than forcing rare event awards.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Pause > Stats > Awards} and identify 30 awards with practical remaining requirements.
Complete each displayed counter through its Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum thresholds.
Continue until 30 award entries display Platinum.

achievements.description: You performed a classic blitz play.
achievements.summary: Complete the Story Mode mission @mechanic{Blitz Play}.

guide.context: This is an automatic story unlock, so no optional medal objective is required.

steps.text: Advance the main story and finish @mechanic{Blitz Play}; the achievement registers after the mission completes.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Hold up all 20 Stores.
achievements.summary: Hold up all 20 original convenience stores in GTA Online.

guide.context: Each store counts when the clerk empties the register; the map icon gains completion once that location has been robbed.

steps.text: Visit each of the 20 store icons in GTA Online freemode.
Aim a weapon at the clerk and keep control of the shop until the cash bag is surrendered.
Escape or lose the police response, then repeat at every unfinished store icon.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Participate in everything Los Santos has to offer.
achievements.summary: In GTA Online, get a haircut and tattoo, buy clothing, play golf, tennis, darts, Shooting Range, and Arm Wrestling, rob a store, and receive a private dance.

guide.context: Participation is sufficient for the leisure activities; only the store robbery must be completed as a successful hold-up.

steps.text: Purchase one haircut, tattoo, and clothing item.
Participate in Golf, Tennis, Darts, a Shooting Range match, and Arm Wrestling.
Successfully rob one shop and purchase one lap dance inside @loc{Vanilla Unicorn}.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Complete a Job as a member of a Crew.
achievements.summary: Join a Rockstar Games Social Club Crew and complete any GTA Online Job while representing that Crew.

guide.context: Crew membership must be active on the character when the Job reaches its results screen.

steps.text: Join a Crew through Social Club or the GTA Online Crew menu and set that Crew as active.
Launch and complete any GTA Online Job while the active Crew tag is displayed.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Kill the thief that mugged you.
achievements.summary: Carry at least $5,000 cash, have a Rank 50 player send Lamar's mugger after you, then chase down and kill the mugger.

guide.context: The assisting player must be Rank 50 to use Lamar's $1,000 mugger service; banked money is safe, but the victim needs enough cash on hand for the NPC to steal.

steps.text: Withdraw at least $5,000 so the target character is carrying cash.
Have a Rank 50 player open @mechanic{Phone > Contacts > Lamar > Call Mugger}, pay $1,000, and select the target character.
After the mugger knocks the character down and steals the cash, pursue the marked NPC and kill the mugger.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Call for a Backup Helicopter for the first time.
achievements.summary: Reach GTA Online Rank 20, call @npc{Merryweather}, and purchase @mechanic{Helicopter Backup} for $5,000.

guide.context: The service unlocks through Merryweather's Rank 20 call and awards the achievement when the support helicopter is requested.

steps.text: Reach Rank 20 and wait for Merryweather's service-unlock phone call.
Open Phone > Contacts > @npc{Merryweather}, choose @mechanic{Helicopter Backup}, and pay $5,000.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Own an Apartment, Garage and an Insured Vehicle.
achievements.summary: In GTA Online, own an apartment, a garage, and one insured personal vehicle.

guide.context: An apartment with an included garage satisfies both property requirements; a tutorial vehicle is insured automatically.

steps.text: Claim or buy a vehicle and apply a Tracker plus Full Coverage at Los Santos Customs if the tutorial did not insure one.
Use @mechanic{Dynasty 8} to buy an apartment that includes a garage, or buy the apartment and garage separately.
Enter the owned property after all three assets appear on the character.

achievements.description: Explore all of Los Santos and Blaine County.
achievements.summary: Reveal at least 98% of the Story Mode map across Los Santos and Blaine County.

guide.context: The world is open from the beginning, and unexplored slivers are easiest to expose from the air.

steps.text: Use a fast plane or helicopter and fly a close grid over the coastline, city, desert, mountains, and offshore islands.
Inspect the pause-map fog and revisit every remaining dark patch until explored coverage reaches 98%.

achievements.description: You played GTA V in first person mode for 15 hours.
achievements.summary: Accumulate 15 real hours using the @mechanic{first-person camera} in Story Mode, GTA Online, or both.

guide.context: The first-person timer is shared across the two modes and can be checked under Pause > Stats > General.

steps.text: Press @mechanic{V} until the camera enters first-person view, then play Story Mode or GTA Online with that view active.
Check @mechanic{Pause > Stats > General > Time Played in First Person} and continue until it reaches 15 hours.

achievements.description: Complete an original GTA Online Heist setup.
achievements.summary: Complete the first setup mission of an original Lester Heist.

guide.context: Hosting requires Rank 12 and a high-end apartment, but joining another host's setup can also satisfy the setup completion.

steps.text: Reach Rank 12 and buy a @mechanic{Dynasty 8 > High End} apartment, or accept an invitation to an original Heist setup.
If hosting, meet Lester at his garment factory and begin @mechanic{The Fleeca Job}.
Complete the first setup mission and reach its results screen.

achievements.description: Complete The Humane Labs Raid and Series A Funding.
achievements.summary: Complete all setups and finales for both @mechanic{The Humane Labs Raid} and @mechanic{Series A Funding}.

guide.context: These are Lester's third and fourth original Heists; both use four-player teams and allow either leader or crew credit.

steps.text: Complete every setup and the finale of @mechanic{The Humane Labs Raid}.
Complete every setup and the finale of @mechanic{Series A Funding}.

achievements.description: Complete The Fleeca Job and The Pacific Standard Job.
achievements.summary: Complete all setups and finales for both @mechanic{The Fleeca Job} and @mechanic{The Pacific Standard Job}.

guide.context: Fleeca uses two players while Pacific Standard uses four; either host or crew participation counts.

steps.text: Complete both setups and the finale of @mechanic{The Fleeca Job}.
Complete every setup and the finale of @mechanic{The Pacific Standard Job}.

achievements.description: Complete The Prison Break as leader or crew.
achievements.summary: Complete every setup and the finale of @mechanic{The Prison Break} as host or crew.

guide.context: The Prison Break is Lester's second original Heist, uses four players, and may be completed in either the leader or crew role.

steps.text: Join or host @mechanic{The Prison Break}.
Complete its Plane, Bus, Station, and Wet Work setups.
Complete The Prison Break finale and reach the results screen.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Invest your hard earned cash to set up a Heist.
achievements.summary: Host an original Lester Heist and personally pay its setup cost.

guide.context: Lester pays the tutorial Fleeca setup, so the first reliable personal payment is the $40,000 Prison Break setup.

steps.text: Reach Rank 12, own a high-end apartment, and complete @mechanic{The Fleeca Job} as host.
Answer Lester's next call, enter the apartment planning room, and pay the displayed setup cost for @mechanic{The Prison Break}.

achievements.description: GTA Online: As Heist Leader set the finale cut as 25% across all players.
achievements.summary: As Heist Leader, set all four finale cuts to exactly 25% and complete that original Heist finale.

guide.context: The Fleeca Job has only two players, so use Prison Break, Humane Labs, Series A, or Pacific Standard.

steps.text: Host and finish the setups for a four-player original Lester Heist.
On the finale payout screen, set the leader and each of the three crew members to 25%.
Launch and complete the finale with that equal split.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Spend a total of $8,000,000 purchasing vehicles included as part of The Heists Update.
achievements.summary: Spend $8,000,000 on base purchase prices of vehicles introduced in the original @mechanic{Heists Update}.

guide.context: Discounted prices contribute only the amount actually paid, while upgrades do not count; repeatedly buying and reselling an eligible vehicle still advances purchase spending.

steps.text: In the vehicle websites, identify vehicles labeled as part of @mechanic{The Heists Update}.
Buy eligible vehicles until the combined purchase prices paid reach $8,000,000.
If storage or cash is limited, repeatedly buy and resell an eligible vehicle such as the Karin Kuruma.
steps.note: Resale returns part of the money, but only each new purchase price advances the counter.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Complete a Heist finale without taking any damage.
achievements.summary: Complete one original Lester Heist finale without the achievement-seeking character taking any health or armor damage.

guide.context: Only personal damage matters; The Fleeca Job is the safest finale because the armored Kuruma shields both players during the escape.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{The Fleeca Job} finale with full health and armor.
Avoid collisions and gunfire while approaching the bank, and move directly into the armored Kuruma when the alarm starts.
Stay inside the Kuruma throughout the police escape and finish the finale without either health or armor decreasing.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Earn 25 platinum medals across Heist Setups and Finales.
achievements.summary: Earn 25 @mechanic{Platinum Medals} across original Lester Heist setups and finales.

guide.context: Only original Heist result medals count; Doomsday Heist medals do not advance this counter.

steps.text: Play original Lester Heist setups and finales while minimizing deaths, damage, delays, and failed role objectives.
Lead the team in kills, accuracy, objective interactions, and role speed to receive the Platinum result medal.
Replay the short Fleeca setups and finale as needed until 25 Platinum medals have accumulated.

achievements.description: Create and export a video using the Rockstar Editor or enter Director Mode 5 times.
achievements.summary: Create and export one Rockstar Editor video, or enter @mechanic{Director Mode} five times.

guide.context: The Enhanced achievement description supports either route; five Director Mode entries avoid external video-account setup.

steps.text: From Story Mode, open @mechanic{Pause > Rockstar Editor > Director Mode}.
Select any actor, enter Director Mode, return to the trailer, and repeat until five entries have registered.

achievements.description: Create and export 10 videos using the Rockstar Editor or enter Director Mode 10 times.
achievements.summary: Create and export ten Rockstar Editor videos, or enter @mechanic{Director Mode} ten times.

guide.context: Only the entry count matters on the Director Mode route; video creation and actor variety are not required.

steps.text: Repeat the Director Mode entry-and-return cycle with any unlocked actor.
Continue until the cumulative total reaches ten Director Mode entries.

achievements.description: Unlock all Special Characters and enter Director Mode as an actor from this category.
achievements.summary: Meet all 12 recruitable @npc{Special Characters}, then enter Director Mode as one Special Character.

guide.context: Special Characters appear as light-blue encounters in Story Mode; the Mime and Dancer are not part of the actor list.

steps.text: In western Los Santos, speak with @npc{Andy Moon} at Cortes Street and Magellan Avenue in Vespucci, @npc{Jesse} at the west end of Red Desert Avenue on Del Perro Beach, @npc{Baygor} on Portola Drive near Vangelico, and @npc{Jane} at Dorset Drive and Rockford Drive in Burton.

In central Los Santos, speak with @npc{Mani} at Occupation Avenue and Elgin Avenue in Alta, @npc{Pamela Drake} at Power Street and Vinewood Boulevard, @npc{Graham the Vinewood Zombie} at Vinewood Boulevard and Alta Street, and @npc{Impotent Rage} outside Hardcore Comic Store on Eclipse Boulevard.
In southern Los Santos, speak with @npc{Jerome} outside South LS Liquor at Carson Avenue and Dutch London Street in Rancho.

In Blaine County, speak with @npc{Griff} outside Larry's RV Sales on Route 68 in Harmony, @npc{Clinton} at Marina Drive and Armadillo Avenue in Sandy Shores, and @npc{Bill Binder} on Cascabel Avenue in Paleto Bay.
Approach each light-blue encounter and complete the conversation that adds the character to Director Mode; leave the area and return if a character is absent.
Open @mechanic{Director Mode > Actors > Special Characters} and enter as any unlocked Special Character.

achievements.description: Enter Director Mode for the first time as an unlocked actor.
achievements.summary: Enter @mechanic{Director Mode} once as any unlocked actor.

guide.context: Director Mode is available from the Rockstar Editor pause-menu section while Story Mode is off mission, out of a vehicle, and free of a wanted level.

steps.text: In Story Mode free roam, open @mechanic{Pause > Rockstar Editor > Director Mode}.
Open @mechanic{Actors}, select any unlocked actor, and load into Director Mode.

achievements.description: Enter Director Mode as an unlocked animal actor for the first time.
achievements.summary: Eat one land @item{Peyote Plant} in Story Mode, then enter Director Mode as the unlocked animal.

guide.context: Each standard Peyote unlocks an animal actor after the transformation; marine animals are not needed for the first animal entry.

steps.text: At @loc{Los Santos International Airport}, go to the Los Santos Customs building, walk down its right-hand side from the garage entrance, and eat the @item{Peyote Plant} beside the forklift.
Allow the animal transformation to begin, then end the hallucination.
Open @mechanic{Director Mode > Actors > Animals} and enter as the newly unlocked animal.

achievements.description: Unlock all Story Characters and enter Director Mode as an actor from this category.
achievements.summary: Finish Story Mode, unlock every Story Character actor, and enter Director Mode as one Story Character.

guide.context: The full Story Characters category becomes available through campaign completion rather than by locating actors in free roam.

steps.text: Complete the Story Mode finale.
Open @mechanic{Director Mode > Actors > Story Characters}, select Michael, Franklin, or Trevor, and enter the world.

achievements.description: Enter Director Mode as Cris Formage.
achievements.summary: Complete the Epsilon Program, then enter Director Mode as @npc{Cris Formage}.

guide.context: Cris Formage is added to the Story Characters category only after the Kifflom! chain is resolved.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Unknowing the Truth} as Michael.
Open @mechanic{Director Mode > Actors > Story Characters}, select @npc{Cris Formage}, and enter the world.

achievements.description: Visit all Locations in Director Mode.
achievements.summary: Visit all 22 selectable @mechanic{Locations} in Director Mode.

guide.context: Visited destinations show a green check beside their yellow location dot, making the short teleport sweep self-tracking.

steps.text: Enter Director Mode as any actor and press @mechanic{M} to open the Interaction Menu.
Choose @mechanic{Location} and teleport to each of the 22 entries, confirming a green check appears before moving to the next.

achievements.description: Enter Director Mode using any of your own GTA Online characters.
achievements.summary: Create a GTA Online character, then enter Director Mode as that character from @mechanic{Online Characters}.

guide.context: The Online Characters category remains empty until the linked account has entered GTA Online with a created character.

steps.text: Create a GTA Online character and finish loading into GTA Online at least once.
Return to Story Mode, open @mechanic{Director Mode > Actors > Online Characters}, and select that character.

achievements.description: Unlock all required animal actors and enter Director Mode as an animal.
achievements.summary: Collect all 21 land-and-sky animal @item{Peyote Plants}, then enter Director Mode as any animal.

guide.context: The 22nd animal actor uses a separate secret condition and is not required for the achievement.

steps.text: Collect the airport plant beside the forklift on the right side of @loc{Los Santos Customs at LSIA}; collect the @loc{La Puerta} plant behind home plate on the baseball field east of the canal; and collect the @loc{El Burro Heights} plant through the fence gap in the southwest corner of the southernmost-road car park.

At @loc{Mirror Park}, go behind the third residence on the right along the eastern dead-end street and check the potted plant on its rear porch; at @loc{Vespucci Beach}, land on the Venetian Hotel skybridge roof and check the grass by its pool; and in @loc{West Vinewood}, land on the south side of the Gentry Manor Hotel roof and check its planters.

Collect three @loc{Vinewood Hills} plants: in the rocks east of the ranger station northwest of the amphitheater, at the edge of the concrete drain beside the northernmost east-west residential road, and behind shrubs south of the small rest area northeast of Galileo Observatory.

At @loc{Tongva Hills}, follow the south bank toward Two Hoot Falls and check the rocky outcrop; north of @loc{Fort Zancudo Water Treatment Plant}, follow the dry creek toward Mount Josiah to the trees and search the roadside shrubs.

Collect three desert plants: west of @loc{McKenzie Field} among large cacti north of the oil derricks, west of the south end of @loc{Redwood Lights Track} midway between the hilltop radio tower and construction site, and beside the water tank behind the painted @item{Peace} trailer at the north end of @loc{RON Alternates Wind Farm}.

Collect two @loc{Raton Canyon} plants: beside the shrubs south of the easternmost viewing platform on the river's southern hiking trail, and atop the rocky outcrop overlooking the river, which requires a helicopter or skydive.

At @loc{Paleto Bay}, check beside the bench on the obstacle-course hill northwest of town; on @loc{Mount Chiliad}, check two separate plants: one between the red-ribbon poles along the path from the summit's @mechanic{Danger! Bell's End} sign, and one on the flat shelf south of the tent settlement east of Paleto Bay.

At @loc{Mount Gordo}, check beneath the tree nearest the south corner of the summit yoga lake; for the final sky animal, land on the southeasternmost tiny rocky island in the group east of @loc{Tataviam Mountains}.
Confirm that all 21 land-and-sky transformations registered; the six sea-animal plants at LSIA, Del Perro Pier, the Pacific Ocean, and Alamo Sea are not part of this achievement route.
Open @mechanic{Director Mode > Actors > Animals} and confirm all required animal actors are available.
Enter Director Mode as any animal after the required roster is complete.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Set up The Doomsday Heist.
achievements.summary: Own a @loc{Facility}, register as a VIP, CEO, or MC President, and pay to set up @mechanic{The Data Breaches}.

guide.context: A Facility provides the Doomsday planning room; invited crew can play without owning one, but this setup achievement requires leadership.

steps.text: Buy a @loc{Facility} from @mechanic{Maze Bank Foreclosures}.
Register as a VIP, CEO, or MC President and meet Lester in the Facility planning room.
Select @mechanic{The Data Breaches} and pay its displayed setup cost.

achievements.description: Complete Act I: The Data Breaches.
achievements.summary: Complete every Prep, Setup, and the finale for Act 1, @mechanic{The Data Breaches}, as leader or crew.

guide.context: Invited crew members do not need to own a Facility or pay the setup cost; those requirements belong to the host.

steps.text: Join or host Act 1, @mechanic{The Data Breaches}.
Complete all required Prep and Setup missions for Act 1.
Complete the @mechanic{The Data Breaches} finale.

achievements.description: Complete Act II: The Bogdan Problem.
achievements.summary: Complete every Prep, Setup, and the finale for Act 2, @mechanic{The Bogdan Problem}, as leader or crew.

guide.context: Invited crew members do not need to own a Facility or pay the setup cost; those requirements belong to the host.

steps.text: Join or host Act 2, @mechanic{The Bogdan Problem}.
Complete all required Prep and Setup missions for Act 2.
Complete the @mechanic{The Bogdan Problem} finale.

achievements.description: Complete Act III: The Doomsday Scenario.
achievements.summary: Complete every Prep, Setup, and the finale for Act 3, @mechanic{The Doomsday Scenario}, as leader or crew.

guide.context: Invited crew members do not need to own a Facility or pay the setup cost; those requirements belong to the host.

steps.text: Join or host Act 3, @mechanic{The Doomsday Scenario}.
Complete all required Prep and Setup missions for Act 3.
Complete the @mechanic{The Doomsday Scenario} finale.

achievements.description: Complete all three Doomsday Heist acts as leader or crew.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The Data Breaches}, @mechanic{The Bogdan Problem}, and @mechanic{The Doomsday Scenario} entirely as leader or entirely as crew.

guide.context: The three role-specific awards track Act I, II, and III separately; mixing leader and crew roles between acts does not complete one full set.

steps.text: Choose either the leader route or the crew route before starting the three-act run.
Complete every Prep, Setup, and finale in The Data Breaches, The Bogdan Problem, and The Doomsday Scenario using that same role.
Confirm the three corresponding Act awards under @mechanic{Pause > Stats > Awards > The Doomsday Heist}.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Kill another player with the Orbital Cannon.
achievements.summary: Use a Facility's @item{Orbital Cannon} to kill another GTA Online player.

guide.context: The cannon is inside an owned Facility and has a real-time cooldown; automatic targeting refunds a failed shot when the target cannot be hit.

steps.text: Enter the Orbital Cannon room inside an owned @loc{Facility}.
Choose manual targeting for $500,000 or automatic targeting for $750,000, then select an exposed player.
Fire the cannon and confirm the blast kills the targeted player.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Complete all 3 Elite Challenges in The Doomsday Heist.
achievements.summary: Complete all three Doomsday Elite finales without player deaths, Quick Restart, or Trip Skip: Act I under 5:30 with 78 kills, Act II under 15:00 with under 5% Avenger damage, and Act III under 30:00 with 150 headshots and clean hacks.

guide.context: All three finales forbid player deaths, Quick Restart, and Trip Skip; the Elite awards may be earned in any order and persist between sessions.

steps.text: For @mechanic{The Data Breaches}, finish under 5:30 with at least 78 team kills and no player death.
For @mechanic{The Bogdan Problem}, finish under 15:00 with the Avenger taking less than 5% damage and no player death.
For @mechanic{The Doomsday Scenario}, finish under 30:00 with 150 team headshots, no hacking mistake, and no player death.
Avoid Quick Restart and Trip Skip, then confirm all three Elite awards under @mechanic{Pause > Stats > Awards > The Doomsday Heist}.

achievements.description: GTA Online: Complete all 3 Criminal Mastermind challenges in The Doomsday Heist.
achievements.summary: Complete Criminal Mastermind II, III, and IV: all Doomsday missions in order, on Hard, without Setup or Finale deaths, using fixed teams of two, three, and four.

guide.context: These are three separate full runs. Keep each roster unchanged and check the in-game award counter after every mission because a reset requires restarting that team-size run.

steps.text: Assemble a fixed two-player team, set every Setup and Finale to @mechanic{Hard}, and complete all three acts in order without either player dying.
Repeat the entire ordered Hard run with one fixed three-player team and no Setup or Finale deaths.
Repeat the entire ordered Hard run with one fixed four-player team and no Setup or Finale deaths.
After every mission, check Criminal Mastermind II, III, or IV under @mechanic{Pause > Stats > Awards > The Doomsday Heist} before continuing.
